comparisons.peer_topic: Accounting for rewards and partner payments
comparisons.peer_summary: Direct costs include rewards and credit card partner payments. Rewards liabilities are estimated based on past redemption behavior and historical card performance, and reduced as points are redeemed. Payments to credit card partners are based on revenue-sharing agreements driven by transactions and sales volumes, which also grant the Corporation exclusive rights to market to the partner's members.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Bank of America disclose financial arrangements with credit card partners, but they differ in structure: Citi provides guarantees compensating partners for shortfalls in customer origination volume and revenue targets, whereas Bank of America makes payments based on revenue-sharing agreements driven by transactions and sales volumes in exchange for exclusive marketing rights.

sentences.text: Citi, in one of its credit card partner arrangements, provides guarantees to the partner regarding the volume of certain customer originations and a minimum revenue target to be achieved by the program during the term of the agreement.

To the extent that such origination and revenue targets are not met, the guarantees serve to compensate the partner for certain payments that otherwise would have been generated in connection with such originations and revenues generated by the program.
The Corporation also makes payments to credit card partners.
The payments are based on revenue-sharing agreements that are generally driven by cardholder transactions and partner sales volumes.

comparisons.comparison: Goldman Sachs discloses data on gross credit card loans by FICO scores but explicitly excludes them from certain vintage loan tables and notes it had no credit card loans at amortized cost in subsequent periods, whereas Citi actively manages credit card partner arrangements with explicit volume and revenue guarantee targets.

comparisons.peer_topic: Accounting treatment of payments to co-brand partners
comparisons.peer_summary: Payments to partners for marketing and loyalty rewards are expensed or reduce card income when incurred, while payments for new account originations are deferred as direct loan origination costs and recognized over 12 months, and sales volume payments reduce income as interchange is earned.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and JPMorgan make payments to co-brand credit card partners, but Citi compensates partners for failing to meet specific origination and revenue volume targets, while JPMorgan accounts for partner payments based on marketing efforts, loyalty rewards, new account originations, and sales volumes without mentioning performance guarantees for shortfalls.

sentences.text: To the extent that such origination and revenue targets are not met, the guarantees serve to compensate the partner for certain payments that otherwise would have been generated in connection with such originations and revenues generated by the program.

The Firm typically makes payments to the co-brand credit card partners based on the cost of partners' marketing activities and loyalty program rewards provided to credit cardholders, new account originations and sales volumes.

comparisons.peer_topic: General Partner Guarantees in Investment Funds
comparisons.peer_summary: As a general partner in investment management funds, the Firm receives performance-based distributions but may be required to return portions to limited partners if they do not achieve specified returns, subject to agreement limitations.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Morgan Stanley disclose guarantee-like obligations, but Citi’s relate to credit card partner revenue/origination shortfalls, whereas Morgan Stanley’s relate to investment fund general partner performance targets and the potential obligation to return distributions if partners fail to achieve specified returns.

sentences.text: Citi, in one of its credit card partner arrangements, provides guarantees to the partner regarding the volume of certain customer originations and a minimum revenue target to be achieved by the program during the term of the agreement.

To the extent that such origination and revenue targets are not met, the guarantees serve to compensate the partner for certain payments that otherwise would have been generated in connection with such originations and revenues generated by the program.

As a general partner in certain investment management funds, the Firm receives certain distributions from the partnerships when the return exceeds specified performance targets according to the provisions of the partnership agreements.

The Firm may be required to return all or a portion of such distributions to the limited partners in the event the limited partners do not achieve a certain return as specified in the various partnership agreements, subject to certain limitations.
